commentary: Graded the two system walks against the diff from the commit that added the external return (5ed88e4) to HEAD. Every file in that range is in some entry's edit record, so the residual check names nothing. The help text, the shared single-name rule, the Purpose and the Trail row are present at every claimed site, with no residue of either old description or either private copy of the rule. The W1 edit is confined to composeDecisionRecord: the run-summary path still writes by temp file and rename, unchanged. The exclusive temp file plus link, the cleanup that never touches another writer's temporary file, and the all-duplicates refusal are each held by a test that the walk's mutation run showed can fail. A temporary file stranded by a hard kill does not block later writes: the token bump reads its token and moves past it. The W2 own-property reads cover the citation table and the command table; every other keyed lookup on the decision path is reached only after the command is validated. One cosmetic remnant, below finding level: the JSDoc above the removed isValidTargetName now introduces no declaration.
